titulo: Summer heat deaths in 2026 reached record high of 5,258 in England
cuerpo: Figure for May to September is far higher than previous peak of 2,985 since records began a decade ago More than 5,200 deaths in England in 2026 were linked to summer heat, the highest provisional annual total since records began a decade ago, according to the UK Health Security Agency. The government agency said 5,258 deaths were associated with extreme heat between May and September 2026. Continue reading...
